svg.text: How IntelliRAG answers, and how it gets better
Sources are prepared once, ahead of time. Each question then takes milliseconds of search before any model runs. What you rate feeds back in.
Runs when you import a source, and in the background. No question needed.
keeps a new link only if
About 5 ms of search on a laptop CPU, then the model, if one is set.
Mark an answer Useful or Dead end, or click "This passage answers my question".
The question is filed against that passage. Next time a similar question ranks it higher (step 4), and sleep builds on it.
